list.title: Knowledge bases
list.description: Knowledge bases you own and ones shared with you.
list.emptyDescription: Create one, or ask someone to share theirs with you.
list.ownedEmptyTitle: You don't own any knowledge bases yet
list.ownedEmptyDescription: Create one to start writing documents.
list.sharedEmptyDescription: Knowledge bases other people share with you appear here after you accept the invitation.

create.title: New knowledge base
create.description: Documents are Markdown files kept in Git.
create.name: Name
create.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens.
create.createdNoRead: Created. Your access doesn't include reading it.

manage.editDescription: Name and description are visible to everyone who can read it.
manage.conflict: Someone else changed these details. Your draft is kept. Close and reopen to load the latest version.
manage.deleteDescription: The knowledge base is removed for everyone. Only its owner can do this.
manage.deleteForbidden: Only the owner can delete this knowledge base.

detail.unavailable: This knowledge base doesn't exist, or you don't have access to it.

editor.pathHint: Relative path ending in .md, e.g. notes/meeting.md
editor.deleteDescription: Deleting creates a new revision. Earlier revisions stay in history.
editor.proposalNote: You can propose changes; a reviewer merges them into main.
editor.readOnlyNote: You can read this knowledge base but not change it.
editor.oldRevision: Viewing revision {{sha}}. Open the latest version to edit.
editor.rejected: The change was rejected. Check the path and content.
editor.gone: The document or knowledge base is no longer available.
editor.retryable: The change may not have been sent. Try again; the same request is reused.
editor.deleteStale: This document changed after you opened it. Review revision {{sha}} below, then confirm again to delete it.
editor.deleteStaleProposal: Your open proposal #{{number}} already has changes. Review this document at its head (revision {{sha}}) below, then confirm again to add the delete to that proposal.

image.hint: Drop or paste images here, or use Insert image. PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, up to 25 MiB.
image.staged: {{name}} is uploaded and linked. It's added to the knowledge base when you save.

error.type: {{name}} isn't a supported image. Use PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP.
error.retryable: Couldn't upload {{name}}. Check your connection and insert it again.
error.rejected: The server refused {{name}}. Its contents must match a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image.
error.gone: The knowledge base is no longer available.

image.waiting: Upload limit reached. {{name}} continues in {{seconds}} s.

editor.uploadExpired: An upload expired before it was saved. Insert any new images again, then save.
editor.tooManyImages: One save can add at most {{max}} new images. Remove some image links, save, then insert the rest.
editor.offline: You're offline. The change will be sent when you reconnect.
editor.deleteProposalDescription: Deleting proposes the removal in your pull request. Main stays unchanged until a reviewer merges it. Earlier revisions stay in history.

outcome.indexNone: No search index update was needed.
outcome.proposedBody: Main is unchanged until a reviewer merges it.
outcome.noopBody: The document already had this content.
outcome.conflictTitle: The document changed since you started
outcome.proposalMovedTitle: Pull request #{{number}} changed since you opened it
outcome.conflictBody: Your text is kept. The branch is now at:
outcome.conflictUnknown: Your text is kept. Reload to see the latest version.
outcome.adoptHead: Continue editing on the new version
outcome.adoptHint: Saving afterwards replaces that version with your text.
outcome.headReadFailed: Couldn't load this document at revision {{sha}}. Try again before you continue.
outcome.headMissing: This document doesn't exist at revision {{sha}}.
outcome.proposalConflictTitle: Pull request #{{number}} still conflicts with main
outcome.proposalConflictBody: Nothing was saved and your text is kept. This save didn't resolve any of the paths below. Resolve them first from the pull request.

search.title: Search
search.queryInvalid: Use valid Unicode text with at most 1024 characters in the query.
search.typeInvalid: Use valid Unicode text with at most 256 characters in the type.
search.titleInvalid: Use valid Unicode text with at most 256 characters in the title.
search.tagsInvalid: Use at most 16 comma-separated tags, each with valid Unicode text and at most 64 characters.
search.indexUnavailable: The search index is unavailable. No results are shown.

indexNotice.EMBEDDING_SETTINGS_CHANGED: Search used the index built with the previous embedding settings; a rebuild is pending.
indexNotice.EMBEDDING_MODEL_CHANGED: Semantic ranking is unavailable because the embedding model changed; a rebuild is pending.
indexNotice.EMBEDDING_RUNTIME_RELOADING: Semantic ranking is temporarily unavailable while the built-in embedding model reloads with new settings.
indexNotice.NO_EMBEDDING_PROFILE: Keyword search only: no embedding model is selected for this knowledge base, so results are not ranked by meaning.
indexNotice.EMBEDDING_PROFILE_REVOKED: Keyword search only: the embedding provider this knowledge base uses was revoked, so results are not ranked by meaning.
indexNotice.EMBEDDING_PROFILE_UNAVAILABLE: Keyword search only: the embedding model isn't available right now (an administrator may have disabled it, or it isn't ready), so results are not ranked by meaning.
indexNotice.SEMANTIC_INDEX_BUILDING: Keyword search only for now: the semantic index for the selected embedding model is still building. Results will be ranked by meaning once it completes.

search.lexicalSettingsLink: Choose an embedding model in settings

media.missing: Missing asset: {{path}}. It isn't in this revision's asset manifest.
media.notPreviewed: {{path}} isn't previewed yet: the preview shows only media this document already uses. Nothing is loaded for it.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.expired: This download expired or is no longer available. Prepare it again.
downloads.error: Couldn't prepare the download. Try again.
downloads.cloneHint: Git asks for a username and password. Use any username and a personal access token with read access as the password. Never put the token in the URL.

diff.drift: The pull request changed while its diff was loading. Refresh to review the current diff.
diff.incomplete_one: {{count}} change loaded so far. More changes remain; load them all before merging.
diff.incomplete_other: {{count}} changes loaded so far. More changes remain; load them all before merging.

files.title: Changed files
files.notMarkdown: Not a Markdown document; see touched assets for media.

review.title: Review
review.closedNote: This pull request was closed without merging.
review.conflicts: This pull request conflicts with main, so it can't be merged. Its author resolves each path listed under Conflicts by saving it again against the current main.

outcome.forbidden: You no longer have permission for this action.
outcome.retryable: The request may not have reached the server. Try again; the same review is resent.

moved.target: Main changed after this diff was shown. Nothing was merged. View the new diff and review it again.
moved.head: The proposal was updated after this diff was shown. Nothing was merged. View the new diff and review it again.
moved.both: Both main and the proposal changed after this diff was shown. Nothing was merged. View the new diff and review it again.
moved.unknown: The proposal or main changed after this diff was shown. Nothing was merged. View the new diff and review it again.

outcome.stateChanged: This pull request was closed or merged by someone else. Nothing was changed. View its current state.

confirm.mergeDescription: Merges proposal {{head}} into main at {{target}}, exactly as displayed.
confirm.closeDescription: The branch and its history stay; the pull request cannot be reopened.

conflicts.title: Conflicts ({{count}})
conflicts.bodyAuthor: Resolve each path below. Saving a document here goes against the current main and moves your pull request onto it.
conflicts.bodyReviewer: The author has to resolve each path below before this pull request can be merged.
conflicts.standing: main's own entry; it resolves together with the other conflicts
conflicts.assetHint: An asset conflict is resolved by adding the asset again or removing it (assetPut or assetRemove over MCP). The web editor can't resolve it.
conflicts.dream: This pull request was opened by a dream run. Only that run can update it, so it can't be resolved here.
conflicts.truncated: Showing the first {{count}} paths. More conflicts remain; they appear here as you resolve these.
conflicts.loadFailed: Couldn't load this pull request's conflicts.

settings.title: Settings
settings.loadFailed: Couldn't load this knowledge base's settings.
settings.unavailable: This knowledge base doesn't exist, or you don't have access to it.

errors.denied: You don't have permission for this anymore. The controls have been refreshed.
errors.conflict: This changed in the meantime. Reload and try again.
errors.invalid: Check the values and try again.

members.title: Members
members.description: People who accepted an invitation, by the name they chose. An invitation stays pending until its recipient accepts it.
members.inviteResult: Invitation recorded. An invitation email is on its way to this address; its owner accepts it with the link, signing up first if needed. This page never reveals whether the address has an account.
members.inviteLink: Acceptance link (you can also share it yourself)
members.revokeDescription: {{name}} loses access to this knowledge base.
members.transferDescription: {{name}} becomes the owner only after accepting. The request is pinned to metadata version {{version}}; any change before acceptance voids it. You stay the owner until then. Once they accept you keep manage access as an ordinary member, which the new owner can remove; sealed values move to the new owner.
members.transferRequested: Transfer requested. The recipient gets an email with this link; you can also send it yourself. Ownership changes only when they accept.
members.includeSealedValuesHint: Off by default. When on, this member's personal access tokens and CLI can be granted sealed values.
members.editDescription: Changes apply to this member's next request, including their tokens and connected apps. Write also grants Read and Propose; Manage grants everything.
members.selfDemoteDescription: You lose the Members and Mirror settings right away and can't give Manage back to yourself. Only the owner can restore it.

accept.shareDescription: You were invited to this knowledge base. Accepting adds it to your list.
accept.transferDescription: You become the owner of this knowledge base and its sealed values. The current owner keeps manage access as an ordinary member, which you can remove.
accept.shareGone: This invitation was already used or replaced. Ask for a new invitation if you still need access.
accept.transferGone: This ownership transfer was already accepted, cancelled or replaced.

profile.title: Embedding profile
profile.description: Choose an enabled built-in model or one of your embedding providers to build this knowledge base's search index.
profile.noChoices: No ready providers are available. Ask an instance admin to enable a built-in model, or add your own under Settings → Embedding providers.
profile.confirmDescription: Embedding every document sends requests to the provider, which may bill you. A usable current index keeps serving search until the new one completes.
profile.keepsActive: The previous index keeps serving search until the new build completes.
profile.lexicalNoProfile: Search is keyword-only: no embedding model is selected. Choose one below to rank results by meaning.
profile.lexicalFailing: Search is keyword-only: the selected embedding model isn't available (it may be disabled, revoked or not ready). Choose an available one below to rank results by meaning.

rebuildPending.EMBEDDING_SETTINGS_CHANGED: Rebuilding (settings changed): search uses the index built with the previous embedding settings until the rebuild finishes.
rebuildPending.EMBEDDING_MODEL_CHANGED: Rebuild pending (model changed): search is lexical-only until the rebuild finishes.
rebuildPending.EMBEDDING_RUNTIME_RELOADING: The built-in embedding model is briefly reloading with new settings: search is keyword-only until it is back.

profile.lexicalNoProfileReader: Search is keyword-only: no embedding model is selected. Someone who can manage this knowledge base can choose one to rank results by meaning.
profile.lexicalFailingReader: Search is keyword-only: the selected embedding model isn't available (it may be disabled, revoked or not ready). Someone who can manage this knowledge base can choose an available one to rank results by meaning.
profile.confirmBuiltinDescription: The built-in model embeds documents on this server without sending requests to an external provider. A usable current index keeps serving search until the new one completes.

sealed.title: Sealed values
sealed.description: Store a secret once. Documents refer to it by an opaque token; the value is never shown again.
sealed.tooLong: The value is larger than 16 KiB.
sealed.referenceHint: Put this token in a document. It is the only thing shown after saving.
sealed.grantDescription: Approve exactly one record for exactly one recipient key. There is no all-records option. A token's holder must be you or a member whose share includes sealed values.
sealed.grantDone: Access granted for this record and this key only.

issues.consumerId: Enter the exact consumer ID (the grant ID for tokens).
issues.recipientKeyId: Enter the recipient key ID (a UUID).
issues.recipientPublicKey: Enter the recipient's X25519 public key (44 base64 characters).
issues.expiresAt: Choose an expiry in the future.

sealed.revokeConfirmDescription: The stored value and every grant for it are destroyed. Documents that still contain the token stop resolving.
sealed.help: A sealed value is a secret, such as an API key or a password, stored encrypted on the server. Documents only contain its opaque reference. A program reads the value only through a grant you approve for one record and one recipient key, and it receives the value encrypted to that key.

mirror.title: Push mirror
mirror.description: Push main one way to an external Git host over SSH. Nothing is pulled back and nothing pushes automatically.
mirror.compromise: The server stores this deploy key's private half encrypted with the instance master key. Anyone who compromises the server or that master key can push to the remote using this deploy key. Grant the deploy key write access to this one repository only.

states.PENDING: A pending key is waiting for verification.

mirror.pendingHint: A pending key never replaces the active key until the server has verified it against the remote.
mirror.publicKeyHint: Add this public key as a deploy key with write access on the remote. The private half is never shown.
mirror.hostKeysHint: Paste the host's full public keys, one per line (for example "ssh-ed25519 AAAA…"). Fingerprints alone are not accepted.
mirror.hostKeysVerify: Compare these SHA256 fingerprints with the ones your Git host publishes before trusting the mirror.
mirror.privateHost: Private, loopback and link-local hosts aren't allowed: the server only pushes to hosts on the public internet. Use your Git host's public address.
mirror.disconnectConfirmDescription: All deploy keys for this knowledge base are destroyed and queued pushes are cancelled. Commits the remote already accepted stay there.

issues.hostKeys: Enter 1 to 8 full host public keys, one per line.

attempts.FAILED: Remote rejected the request. Check its key, host key, and branch history before retrying.
attempts.CANCELLED: Mirror request cancelled because its authority or configuration changed.
attempts.UNKNOWN: Remote outcome unknown. Inspect the remote branch before trying again; accepted commits cannot be rolled back.

index.title: Index settings
index.description: How the search index stores vectors and how many chunks one build may hold.
index.confirmDescription: The index is rebuilt with the new quantization. Embedding every document sends requests to the provider, which may bill you. A usable current index keeps serving search until the new one completes.
index.limitClamped: The stored limit of {{stored, number}} is above the current maximum, so {{limit, number}} applies.
index.limitSheetDescription: A build stops before embedding anything when the knowledge base has more chunks than this limit.
index.limitInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to {{max, number}}.

reasons.INVALID_AMOUNT: Enter a whole number of at least 1.
reasons.CHUNK_LIMIT_ABOVE_CEILING: That limit is above the maximum of {{max, number}}.
reasons.CHUNK_LIMIT_ABOVE_QUANTIZATION_BOUND: The chunk limit is above this quantization's maximum. Lower the chunk limit first.
reasons.ACTIVE_INDEX_TOO_LARGE: The current index has more chunks than this quantization allows, so a rebuild would fail.

buildFailure.CHUNK_LIMIT: The last build stopped because the knowledge base has more chunks than its chunk limit. Raise the limit or remove content, then rebuild.
buildFailure.DISK_FULL: The last build stopped because the server ran out of index disk space. Ask an instance admin.

index.quantizationHelp: Quantization stores each embedding in fewer bytes so the index stays small and fast. Compact (int8) keeps one byte per dimension. Binary search with int8 rescoring finds candidates with one bit per dimension, then re-ranks them with the int8 copy, so one build can hold more chunks. Changing it rebuilds the index.
index.confirmBuiltinDescription: The index is rebuilt with the new quantization using the built-in model on this server. A usable current index keeps serving search until the new one completes.

document.proposalClosed: Pull request #{{number}} is no longer open, so this document can't be edited in it.
document.deletedInProposal: This document is deleted in pull request #{{number}}.
document.notInProposal: This document isn't in pull request #{{number}}.
document.downloadDescription: Download this revision as a ZIP file, or clone the knowledge base with Git.
document.notFound: This document doesn't exist at this revision. Check the path or open another revision.

prMode.title: Editing pull request #{{number}}
prMode.body: The draft is your pull request's version. Saving updates the pull request against the current main; main is unchanged until a reviewer merges it.
prMode.conflict: This document conflicts with main. Combine main's version below into your draft, then save to resolve it.
prMode.standing: Main's version of this document stands in the way of your other conflicts. Saving it here resolves it along with them.
prMode.deleted: Pull request #{{number}} deletes this document, so the draft starts from main's version. Saving keeps the document in the pull request.
prMode.mainDeleted: Main deleted this document. Save to keep your version, or accept main's deletion.
prMode.bothDeleted: Both pull request #{{number}} and main deleted this document, but the conflict is still recorded. Keep the deletion to resolve it.
prMode.keepDeletionDescription: Pull request #{{number}} keeps this document deleted. That resolves its conflict here; main is unchanged until a reviewer merges.
prMode.acceptDeletionDescription: Pull request #{{number}} drops its version of this document, as main did. That resolves its conflict here; main is unchanged until a reviewer merges.
prMode.inactive: Pull request #{{number}} is closed or merged. There's nothing left to edit in it.
prMode.dream: Pull request #{{number}} was opened by a dream run. Only that run can update it.
prMode.missing: This document isn't in pull request #{{number}} or on main.
prMode.loadFailed: Couldn't load pull request #{{number}}'s version of this document.
prMode.notice: Your pull request #{{number}} changes this document
prMode.noticeBody: This page shows main's version. Edit the pull request's version to continue your pending change.
prMode.noticeEditing: You're editing main's version. To continue your pending change, edit the pull request's version instead.
